scope: same final build direct versus one managed member alternating; memory includes CSV/core/strategy/normalized receipt hash/retention, explicit init/start excluded; durable includes exact original control prefix+quotes+256 batches SQLite FULL/checkpoints, same-build full audit excluded; 2/8 policies differ in budgets/signals and are first workload baselines, not economic/rate superiority comparisons, individual latency, upstream, alpha or external route
